dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: #Festival Utsava was a very happy time, and Nara {NICKNAME} also received many flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: I am very curious. Why did Golden Nara receive everyone's flowers like the flowers are raindrops converging into river?

dialogues.speaker: Aragaru
dialogues.text: I see, so I had given flowers long ago in the story.
